title: GhostPrefix: Synchronization-Free Universal Prefix Attacks for ASR Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.42026v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present GhostPrefix, the first synchronization-free universal adversarial prefix attack against automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. Unlike prior audio attacks, which are typically crafted per utterance, require synchronization with the victim waveform, or target narrow objectives, GhostPrefix learns a short, reusable audio segment prepended to arbitrary live speech to exert real-time control over ASR outputs without knowledge of the future utterance or temporal alignment. A key challenge is maintaining stable adversarial effects across unknown, evolving speech contexts. GhostPrefix combines token-level losses with a novel representation-level objective for stable, input-agnostic effects. GhostPrefix supports three attack modes: (i) prompted prefix attacks for semantic steering, (ii) targeted prefix attacks for transcript hijacking, and (iii) untargeted prefix attacks for transcription degradation. translated_title: GhostPrefix：面向自动语音识别操纵的无同步通用前缀攻击
translated_abstract: 我们提出了GhostPrefix，这是首个针对自动语音识别（ASR）系统的无同步通用对抗前缀攻击。与现有音频攻击不同——它们通常需要针对每条话语单独制作、需要与受害者波形保持同步、或只能实现狭窄的攻击目标——GhostPrefix学习一个简短且可复用的音频片段，将其前置到任意实时语音之前，从而在无需预知未来话语内容或进行时间对齐的情况下，对ASR输出实现实时控制。该方法的一个关键挑战在于，如何在未知且不断演变的语音环境中保持稳定的对抗效果。GhostPrefix将令牌级别的损失与一种新颖的表示级别目标相结合，以实现稳定的、与输入无关的攻击效果。GhostPrefix支持三种攻击模式：（i）用于语义引导的提示式前缀攻击，（ii）用于转录劫持的定向前缀攻击，以及（iii）用于降低转录质量的非定向前缀攻击。为在感知上保持不显眼……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: GhostPrefix是首个无需同步的通用对抗前缀攻击，通过在任意实时语音前附加一段简短可复用的音频片段，在无需预知话语内容和时间对齐的情况下实时操纵ASR输出，并支持语义引导、转录劫持和转录降质三种攻击模式。
en_tdlr: GhostPrefix is the first synchronization-free universal adversarial prefix attack that prepends a short, reusable audio segment to arbitrary live speech, enabling real-time manipulation of ASR outputs without any knowledge of future utterances or temporal alignment, while supporting semantic steering, transcript hijacking, and transcription degradation attack modes.
